content.short: NameStone issues free ENS subdomains via a REST API, with a powerful admin panel.
content.description: NameStone makes it straightforward to create usernames by issuing ENS subdomains, a capability that benefits smart contract wallets, social platforms, and NFT projects seeking to distribute subnames. Trusted by Web3 businesses and developers, it provides a robust API for seamless, gasless subdomain management and issuance, helping teams streamline onboarding, assign consistent handles, and scale identity distribution without on-chain costs.
